name: Lateral Lunge (Weighted)
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at your chest or a kettlebell in goblet position.
Take a wide step to one side.
Sit back into the hip of the stepping leg while keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest tall and your foot flat.
Push through the stepping foot to return to standing.
longevityNotes: Single-leg strength and balance are what keep you steady on uneven ground and stairs. Lunge work trains the stability that prevents the falls that change lives.
overview: A side lunge with added load that trains the quads, glutes and adductors in the frontal plane.
